evidence_types.descriptive_statistic: Direct descriptive statistic with no paper-method claim
evidence_types.paper_exact: Formula and data conditions reproduced and independently tested
evidence_types.engineering_screening: Engineering proxy; not the cited paper's full method

conditions: PD is interpreted as publication date
incomplete tail years are flagged

analyze_lifecycle.formula: annual publication count, cumulative count, year-over-year change
conditions: describes publication growth only

analyze_ipc_distribution.formula: count valid A-H IPC section assignments by publication year; optional patent or family deduplication
conditions: one patent may contribute to multiple IPC cells

generate_wordcloud.formula: cleaned unigram/phrase document frequency with term frequency and document ratio diagnostics
sources: Tseng et al. 2007, Information Processing & Management 43, 1216-1247
conditions: Derwent template noise is removed
frequency is not importance

analyze_burst_terms.formula: smoothed recent-vs-history document-frequency ratio with minimum support
conditions: at least 5 complete years
at least 50 records in each included year

analyze_yearly_keywords.formula: cleaned unigram/phrase document frequency by publication year
conditions: tail-year completeness is shown

analyze_co_network.formula: undirected edge for each pair of deterministically normalized co-applicants on the same record
conditions: at least 30 multi-applicant patents
multi-applicant rate at least 1%
primary PN office only

analyze_tech_roadmap.formula: annual title themes and representative records ranked by theme coverage plus available backward-reference count
conditions: year is publication year
family citation paths require family, priority-date and edge-resolution gates
every route edge retains source citation evidence

get_dataset_summary.formula: record counts, field coverage, batch manifest and network coverage

search_patents.formula: cosine similarity in word/phrase TF-IDF space; deterministic patent-number tie break
conditions: lexical retrieval, not semantic embedding

read_patent_details.formula: exact lookup of parsed source fields
conditions: Derwent abstract is not the full specification

analyze_tech_matrix.formula: co-occurrence plus marginal support, expected count, lift and Pearson residual for NOVELTY vs USE/ADVANTAGE proxy terms
sources: Tseng et al. 2007, Information Processing & Management 43, 1216-1247
conditions: category cues must be present
minimum support is required
zero cells require record review

analyze_clustering.formula: K-means in character n-gram TF-IDF space with deterministic multi-start random-point initialization and canonical cluster IDs; silhouette and ARI select k; readable labels use segmented terms and CC0.5
sources: Tseng et al. 2007, Information Processing & Management 43, 1216-1247
conditions: at least 100 valid texts
only CC0.5 label criterion is paper-derived

analyze_patent_valuation.formula: source-stratified percentile screening with per-record available-weight normalization and uncertainty interval; citation-network position is normalized by publication year and IPC subclass; SS diagnostic = RO + BC only when family/network gates pass
sources: von Wartburg, Teichert & Rost 2005, Research Policy 34, 1591-1607
Kim & Bae 2017, Technological Forecasting and Social Change 117, 228-237
conditions: missing cells remain missing rather than zero
ranks apply only within a source and available-dimension comparability group
family nodes
citation direction citing-to-cited
European-style share and network closure disclosed
triadic means US+EP+JP

analyze_competitor_evolution.formula: IPC entropy, dominant IPC share and year-to-year cosine distance
conditions: metrics are engineering descriptors at IPC subclass/main-group level

analyze_entity_portfolio.formula: rank canonical party entities by publication, family, grant or source-provided forward-citation count
conditions: party roles remain separate
parent grouping requires a reviewed mapping

analyze_concentration.formula: fractional multi-assignment CR3/5/10, HHI, Gini, Shannon entropy and effective entity count with deterministic bootstrap
conditions: dimension and publication/family counting unit are explicit

analyze_citation_network.formula: citing-to-cited graph with internal/external edge separation, PageRank diagnostics, co-citation, bibliographic coupling and citation age
conditions: edge resolution and node participation are reported
key-path conclusions require an internal-network gate

analyze_family_geography.formula: separate counts for priority origin, first publication office, family publication offices, designated states and authoritative active-right jurisdictions
conditions: each geography semantic is reported separately

audit_search_strategy.formula: version hashes, returned-set increments, removals, unique records, known-patent recovery and citation/family snowball candidates
conditions: all versions use the same lexical baseline
expert labels are required for recall

analyze_legal_status.formula: current source status composition separated from dated legal-event counts
conditions: source declares current_legal_status capability
at least 80% have status as-of dates and jurisdictions
adapter identity is known

monitor_patent_changes.formula: persisted strategy baseline set and selected record-field hashes compared to the current content fingerprint
conditions: content fingerprint and versioned search strategy are stored
notifications are deduplicated by deterministic run id

analyze_claim_elements.formula: source claim dependency tree plus reversible punctuation/conjunction split and literal product-feature matching
conditions: claim text, language and dependency are source fields
publication/grant version and legal status are recognizable
human patent-professional review is mandatory
